what: Legend of the Pankis: Sankaracharya and his disciples drank water from a Ganda; he drank molten metal and said disciples could not; disciples were degraded to the Ganda caste and became Pankis. Sankaracharya is mentioned only in this caste legend.
quote: Sankarachirya said ... I can take water from a Ganda without pollution, ~ but you cannot

what: Kumbhipatia (Mahima/Alekh) sect: "Kumbhipatia Gosains" and "Kanapathia Gosains" have renounced the world; the third group, Ashritas, remain householders. Sect founded c.1864-66 in Cuttack/Dhenkanal (Alekhswami, Gobind Das); a math at Banki. Not Dasnami: a heterodox Hindu movement (code OTHER).
quote: They are divided into three seots, the Kumbhipatia Gosiins, the MKanapathia Gosains, and Ashritas. The two former sects have renounced the world

what: Kumbhipatia maths: Narsingh Das erected his math at Banki; another temple at Malbahar.
quote: another known as Narsingh Das has erected his math (temple) in Banki

what: Kabirpanthi hierarchy: chief Mahant at Kawardha (disputed), another at Kudarmal; Bhandaris or Mahants appointed.
